artboards.title: Home · A frame, B reason lines

annotations.text: Chosen: A's frame with B's reason lines. Tonight stays the surface; Later is a chip (dismissed picks + Letterboxd watchlist), and the pick engine draws from it first.

B · Typographic. The reason line is the hero; posters are footnotes. Serif headline, editorial rhythm.
Tradeoff: least like a streaming app, weakest at showing the art itself.

C · Poster study. The pick is a poster wall of three, the middle one lit. Cinematic, the picture does the work.
Tradeoff: closest to Netflix; needs real TMDB art to hold up.

Title. Poster, headline, one mono facts line, the reason set large, Play. Cast row with the people you already like lit. The brain page below, names as links. Right panel: where this title sits in your taste.

Taste map. You at the center, ring 1 the people you keep watching (accent = liked, dim = meh), ring 2 their titles, the industry graph faint behind. Rail shows the derived facts. Drawer: a selected person, with the one thing of theirs you haven't seen.
